title: Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho Invited as Plenary Speaker at MSPPC 2026 Malaysia

body:
**Yogyakarta, June 2026** – Academic members of the Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems, Faculty of Agricultural Technology at Universitas Gadjah Mada have once again achieved international recognition and contribution. **Assoc. Prof. Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho** has been honored to serve as a **Plenary Speaker** at the **36th Malaysian Society of Plant Physiology Conference (MSPPC 2026)**, which will be held on **28–30 July 2026** at **M Roof Hotel, Ipoh, Perak, Malaysia**.

MSPPC is an annual conference organized by the **Malaysian Society of Plant Physiology (MSPP)** and is one of the important scientific forums in Southeast Asia that brings together researchers, academics, practitioners, and stakeholders in the fields of plant physiology and sustainable agriculture. This year, the conference theme is **"Plant Physiology for Sustainable and Climate-Smart Future"**, highlighting the importance of scientific innovation in addressing climate change and global food security challenges.

In an official invitation letter from the organizing committee, Dr. Andri has been invited to deliver a plenary paper with the title:

> **"Translating Plant Physiological Insights into Data-Driven Precision Agriculture"**

This topic addresses how plant physiology understanding can be translated into data-driven precision agriculture systems through the use of sensors, artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and other digital technologies. This approach is expected to support more accurate decision-making, increase resource use efficiency, and strengthen the agricultural sector's adaptation to climate change.

The plenary session will be held on **28 July 2026** in a **hybrid format**, consisting of a 30-minute recorded video presentation followed by a 5-minute online question-and-answer session with international conference participants.

MSPPC 2026 has two main objectives: to disseminate research results related to plant biodiversity, physiology, conservation, and sustainable production, and to promote multidisciplinary and inter-institutional collaboration in plant physiology research development. The conference covers various strategic topics such as ecophysiology, stress biology, plant production, biotechnology, food security, plant-soil-microbe interaction, climate change, biostimulants, and artificial intelligence in agriculture.

This invitation as a plenary speaker represents international recognition of the research contributions made by Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho and the **Smart Agriculture (SmartAgri) UGM** research group in developing data-driven and technology-based precision agriculture. This participation is also expected to further strengthen the international collaboration networks of the Faculty of Agricultural Technology UGM with various research and educational institutions across Southeast Asia.

Through participation in MSPPC 2026, SmartAgri UGM continues to commit to developing agricultural technology innovations that support productivity, sustainability, and food security in the era of smart and data-driven agriculture.

original.body:
**Yogyakarta, Juni 2026** – Prestasi dan kontribusi internasional kembali diraih oleh sivitas akademika Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian Universitas Gadjah Mada. **Assoc. Prof. Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho** mendapatkan kehormatan untuk menjadi **Plenary Speaker** pada **36th Malaysian Society of Plant Physiology Conference (MSPPC 2026)** yang akan diselenggarakan pada **28–30 Juli 2026** di **M Roof Hotel, Ipoh, Perak, Malaysia**.

MSPPC merupakan konferensi tahunan yang diselenggarakan oleh **Malaysian Society of Plant Physiology (MSPP)** dan menjadi salah satu forum ilmiah penting di kawasan Asia Tenggara yang mempertemukan peneliti, akademisi, praktisi, serta pemangku kepentingan di bidang fisiologi tanaman dan pertanian berkelanjutan. Tahun ini, konferensi mengangkat tema **“Plant Physiology for Sustainable and Climate-Smart Future”**, yang menyoroti pentingnya inovasi ilmiah dalam menghadapi tantangan perubahan iklim dan ketahanan pangan global.

Dalam surat undangan resmi dari panitia, Dr. Andri diundang untuk menyampaikan plenary paper dengan judul:

> **“Translating Plant Physiological Insights into Data-Driven Precision Agriculture”**

Topik tersebut mengangkat bagaimana pemahaman fisiologi tanaman dapat diterjemahkan menjadi sistem pertanian presisi berbasis data melalui pemanfaatan sensor, kecerdasan buatan (Artificial Intelligence), Internet of Things (IoT), serta teknologi digital lainnya. Pendekatan ini diharapkan mampu mendukung pengambilan keputusan yang lebih akurat, meningkatkan efisiensi penggunaan sumber daya, serta memperkuat adaptasi sektor pertanian terhadap perubahan iklim.

Sesi plenary akan dilaksanakan pada tanggal **28 Juli 2026** dalam format **hybrid**, berupa presentasi video rekaman berdurasi 30 menit yang dilanjutkan dengan sesi tanya jawab daring selama 5 menit bersama peserta konferensi internasional.

MSPPC 2026 memiliki dua tujuan utama, yaitu menyebarluaskan hasil penelitian terkait biodiversitas tanaman, fisiologi, konservasi, dan produksi berkelanjutan, serta mendorong kolaborasi multidisiplin dan antar-lembaga dalam pengembangan riset fisiologi tanaman. Konferensi ini mencakup berbagai topik strategis seperti ecophysiology, stress biology, plant production, biotechnology, food security, plant-soil-microbe interaction, climate change, biostimulants, hingga artificial intelligence dalam pertanian.

Undangan sebagai plenary speaker ini menjadi bentuk pengakuan internasional terhadap kontribusi riset yang dilakukan oleh Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho dan kelompok riset **Smart Agriculture (SmartAgri) UGM** dalam pengembangan pertanian presisi berbasis data dan teknologi digital. Partisipasi ini juga diharapkan semakin memperkuat jejaring kolaborasi internasional Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian UGM dengan berbagai institusi penelitian dan pendidikan di kawasan Asia Tenggara.

Melalui keikutsertaan dalam MSPPC 2026, SmartAgri UGM terus berkomitmen untuk mengembangkan inovasi teknologi pertanian yang mendukung produktivitas, keberlanjutan, serta ketahanan pangan di era pertanian cerdas dan berbasis data.
